prompt: A deep open-pit quarry mine carved into dark slate-grey rock, viewed from above the rim. From the lowest exposed mineral seam at the bottom of the pit, the colossal pale-bone skeleton of a long-dead beast is being hauled upward, half-emerged from the stone, its massive horned skull and ribcage breaking free of the rock as a faint cold reanimating glow flickers in its empty eye sockets. Rusted mine scaffolding and chains drape the pit walls. The background is striated brown and grey strata of deep earth under a dim overcast sky.

A deep mine pit in dark slate rock seen in side cross-section, strata layers visible. At the bottom seam a colossal fossilized beast skeleton with a great horned skull is wrenched loose from the stone and rises, dragged up on heavy rusted iron chains, cold blue-white necromantic light glowing in its eye sockets and along the exposed mineral seam. The background is layered brown and grey rock strata fading into black underground depth.

A deep mine cavern of dark slate rock framing the scene. A colossal fossilized beast skeleton with a great horned skull rears upward as it is dragged free of the rock on heavy rusted iron chains hooked around its ribs and skull.
